channel.title: LawnSeedPicker Guides
channel.description: Grass-seed and lawn-care guides, backed by USDA and university extension research.

item.title: Microclover vs. White Clover: What Actually Differs
item.description: Microclover isn't a different species from white clover — it's a dwarf selection of the same plant. What breeders actually changed, which one belongs in a lawn, and why the seeding rate on the bag isn't extension-verified. #microclover #cloverlawn

item.title: Grass Seed Data: Seeding Rates, Seed Counts, and Tolerance Ratings by Species
item.description: Seeding rates, seeds per pound, and shade, drought, heat and wear tolerance ratings for 13 lawn grasses and clovers — every figure sourced to USDA and university extension publications. #grassseed #lawncare

item.title: Best Grass Seed for Shade
item.description: Fine fescue is the most shade-tolerant cool-season grass — why it beats bluegrass and ryegrass in low light, how much shade a lawn actually needs, the go-to 80/10/10 shade mix, and when to switch to a ground cover instead. #shadegrass #lawncare

item.title: Why You Can't Buy St. Augustine Grass Seed
item.description: You can't buy St. Augustine grass seed — and you can't grow a named variety from seed, so it's planted from sod, plugs, or sprigs. Why, how much sod or how many plugs you need, and the warm-season grasses you can seed instead. #staugustinegrass #lawncare

item.title: How Much Grass Seed Do I Need?
item.description: How much grass seed you need comes down to two numbers: your square footage and your grass type's seeding rate. Extension rates by species, plus why coated seed needs more. #grassseed #lawncare

item.title: How to Water New Grass Seed
item.description: How to water new grass seed: light and frequent until germination, then deeper and less often. The full schedule from seeding to first mow. #grassseed #newlawn

item.title: Fix Dog Pee Spots in Your Lawn
item.description: Why dog urine burns grass and how to fix the dead spots: flush fresh spots, repair with reseeding, and pick a urine-tolerant grass. #lawncare #dogfriendly

item.title: Should You Grow a Clover Lawn?
item.description: Clover lawns explained: white clover vs. microclover, the benefits and the real drawbacks, plus how to plant and grow one. #cloverlawn #nolawn

item.title: The Best Grass for a Low-Water Lawn
item.description: The most drought-tolerant lawn grasses: tall fescue and fine fescue, buffalo grass, Bermuda, zoysia, plus clover for a low-water lawn. #droughttolerant #lawncare

item.title: Fix Thin & Bare Lawn Patches for Good
item.description: How to reseed a lawn the right way: clear and loosen the soil, match your seed, sow at the correct rate and depth, and water for strong germination. #lawnrepair #grassseed

item.title: Overseeding: Why Fall Beats Spring
item.description: Overseeding a thin lawn: why fall beats spring, how much seed to use, and how to overseed step by step for a thicker lawn. #overseeding #lawncare

item.title: The Best Time to Plant Grass Seed
item.description: The best time to plant grass seed by grass type and region: cool-season in late summer to early fall, warm-season in late spring. #grassseed #lawntips

item.title: How to Restart Your Lawn From Scratch
item.description: Starting your lawn over from scratch: how to kill what's there, prep the soil, seed, and time it for success, step by step. #lawncare #newlawn

item.title: How to Buy Grass Seed You Can Actually Trust
item.description: Where to actually buy quality grass seed online, how to read a seed label, and how to tell premium seed from filler. A plain-English buyer's guide. #grassseed #lawncare
